source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of bridging the digital divide (PDF 184-185).

items: Sarkari iqdamat: jahan internet infrastructure na ho wahan banana; Pakistan mein Universal Service Fund (USF) dehaat aur door daraz ilaqon tak internet le jata hai.
Taleemi programme: school aur community centres logon ko parhai aur rozmarra kaamon ke liye computer aur internet sikhate hain.
Public-private shirakat: hukumat ka karobar aur ghair munafa idaron ke saath kaam technology ko sasta bana sakta hai.

blocks.text: Kitab batati hai ke hukumat-e-Pakistan ne door daraz ilaqon mein mobile broadband jaise iqdamat kiye hain, magar kai ilaqon mein ab bhi qabil-e-aitbaar rabta nahi (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Digital divide ko kam karne aur sarkari iqdamat ke kirdar ko Pakistan ki misalon ke saath samjhaiye (long question 2).
blocks.explanation: Faasla kam karne ka matlab sab ko aalaat, rabte aur maharat tak munsifana rasai dena hai ta ke sab ko seekhne, kaam karne aur hissa lene ke barabar mauqe milein. Hukumat ka markazi kirdar hai kyunke woh wahan infrastructure ke paise de sakti hai jahan companies ko kam munafa dikhta hai: Universal Service Fund dehaat aur door daraz ilaqon tak internet pohanchata hai, aur mobile broadband mansoobe dehi ilaqon tak pohanchte hain. Hukumat schools mein digital khwandagi aur karobar aur ghair munafa idaron se shirakat kar ke aalaat aur data ko sasta bhi bana sakti hai. Faasle ab bhi baqi hain, to yeh koshishein jari rehni chahiyein.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: chhota paragraph likhein ke aap ka school ya community digital divide kam karne mein kaise madad kar sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: school ki computer lab weekend par walidain aur parosiyon ke liye khul sakti, bare students bunyadi phone aur internet ki maharat sikha sakte, aur purane aalaat theek kar ke baghair aalaat wale khandanon ko diye ja sakte hain.

items: Faasla infrastructure (USF), digital khwandagi aur public-private shirakat se kam karein.
